notes: Governing documents: USG Board of Regents Policy Manual 8.2.7 (leave: sick leave with and without pay, FMLA, personal leave, vacation) and 8.3.7.4 (suspension of the tenure probationary period) cover all USG employees including UGA tenure-stream faculty; UGA's own layer is the Academic Affairs Policy Manual 1.11-1.12, the Provost's tenure-extension guidelines, and the UGA HR policy pages (Maternity Leave, sick leave, personal leave, FMLA). missing is false: these are governing leave and tenure-clock policies for UGA faculty.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave exists in the saved documents: a birth mother's paid time comes only from her own accrued sick leave (c2, c3; 0 paid weeks under R1/R1b), then discretionary unpaid sick leave (c4), within FMLA's 12 unpaid workweeks (c1). Academic-year faculty earn no vacation (c6 covers fiscal-year faculty only).

Unit-level policies (V3b; recorded, not main campus): Franklin College of Arts and Sciences (2018_17, 2018_22, 2018_23) and SPIA (2018_25). The Provost page (2018_16) refers units without their own policy to the Franklin and SPIA policies ('are encouraged to refer'), which does not adopt them university-wide. Franklin's 2018_17 states 'Leaves of absence and reassignments of location do not interrupt the tenure clock' in the context of educational/professional leave, and points to the Provost extension guidelines (c8).

Navigation or index pages with no policy of their own: 2018_11 (Provost APT index), 2018_14 (HR leave index, lists leave types), 2018_18 (SPIA faculty/staff information page, links to the SPIA Leave Policy), 2018_05 (pointer to the HR FMLA site); 2018_02 and 2018_03 are AAPM pointer sections (to HR leave policies and the tenure-extension guidelines).

Leaves read and not coded because a parent cannot use them for a birth: educational and professional leave (BOR 8.2.7.4, AAPM 1.12-1, Franklin 2018_17; scholarly purposes only), military leave, court duty, voting, military physical, organ and marrow donation, education support leave (8 hours, school support), inclement weather/emergency leave, leave without pay for political candidacy.

Franklin's 2018_17 lists 'personal reasons' among the purposes of a faculty leave of absence; it states that the College's leave policies are those of the Provost, UGA and the BOR, so it is recorded with the BOR personal leave (c5), not as a separate component.

UGA HR (quoted by Franklin 2018_22): family leave may not be taken intermittently for a birth or placement unless the employee and supervisor agree; SPIA: intermittent or reduced-schedule FMLA for well-child care is at the institution's discretion. Recorded here only; not a part-time option.

FMLA (c1): UGA requires accrued annual or sick leave to run concurrently with FMLA leave and leave without pay only after balances are exhausted (Franklin 2018_23 and SPIA 2018_25 state the University's rule; HR 2018_06 puts an employee without balance on sick or personal leave without pay).

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1), concurrent with the HR maternity sick-leave period (c2, 6-8 weeks from her own sick balance); accrued sick leave with pay (c3) within FMLA; then, once sick and vacation balances are exhausted, discretionary sick leave without pay up to 1 year (c4, consecutive_after c3); then discretionary personal leave without pay up to 1 year (c5, general purpose, consecutive_after c4). Tenure clock: suspension during an approved leave (c7) or a one-year extension (c8), both discretionary.

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) for the birth and care of the newborn, with accrued sick leave (c3, family illness) within it; personal leave (c5, general purpose) otherwise unplaced. Tenure clock c7/c8 as for the birth parent.

Documents cited but not saved: UGA HR 'How FMLA may affect my accumulated leave time', 'FMLA Terms and Definitions', 'FMLA leave coverage examples'; HR 'Short term disability insurance', 'Long term disability insurance', 'Shared leave program', 'Faculty Leave' pages; UGA policy 'Vacation & Annual Leave' (node 1158) and 'Other types of Leave' (node 1111); USG Human Resources Administrative Practice Manual; USG Academic Affairs Handbook; UGA Administrative Policies and Procedures Manual p. 71.1-16-25 and the UGA Personnel Handbook (quoted by Franklin 2018_22); Franklin College Checklist for Requesting FMLA; UGA Tenure Clock Calendar; Guidelines for Appointment, Promotion and Tenure (Spring 2017); UGA Telecommuting eligibility requirements, Guidelines and Conditions; UGA Graduate School Enrollment Policy; O.C.G.A. 34-1-6.

Version notes: the Franklin Work/Life statement (2018_23, file dated May 2013, captured 2019-07-12) and the SPIA Leave Policy (2018_25, PDF metadata 2017-02-03, captured 2021-10-26) are read as in force on 2018-03-13 per the documents' version notes; SPIA components carry version_uncertain. Neither counts (single unit, V3b).
Calendar: the BOR and AAPM refer to fall, spring and summer semesters; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
